milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate near the blue banner (placed on the east exterior wall of the spruce building at spawn-relative coordinates -6, 2, 6) and face toward it. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable viewing distance, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the banner rather than facing away from it.
